sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fitness Biometric Tracking and Wellness Telemetry Apps

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law heritage with French civil law influences; Codified commercial legislation)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) — regional free trade agreement
Membership of the World Trade Organization (since 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 243] as amended; International Companies Act [Cap. 222] as amended (in particular beneficial ownership and record-keeping provisions); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Directives issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission under the VFSC Act [Cap. 240].

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the owner's country of residence / notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at the Vanuatu Diplomatic Mission or authorized representative office

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the document origin country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter attesting to good standing of the account holder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding bank in the document origin country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: If a corporate shareholder is involved: certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and board resolution authorizing shareholding
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry and notary in the foreign jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization of all corporate documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC specifically designated nationals (SDN) list, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions and enforcement lists maintained by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons (PEPs), their family members, and close associates; PEP status must be disclosed in the UBO declaration and subject to senior management approval.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry – Online Name Reservation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Roman characters; English, French, and Bislama words are permissible. No foreign scripts, diacritics, or symbols are accepted. The standard corporate suffix for a Vanuatu International Company is 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or 'Société Anonyme', or abbreviated forms thereof, as permitted by the International Companies Act.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event of a name rejection, the applicant or licensed registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. The appeal must state the proposed name, the statutory basis for its validity, and any special justifications. The appeal is lodged using VFSC Form 4 (Name Reservation Appeal) and must be submitted within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. VFSC will issue a determination within 7 business days of receipt. If the rejection is upheld, the applicant may resubmit a name reservation request with an alternate name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not independently acceptable as the sole registered office for an International Company. The company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the physical address of a licensed registered agent. An operational virtual office may be used for business administration, but it cannot replace the statutory registered office. For a digital health fitness application, the absence of a physical local operational office does not constitute a compliance violation provided the registered agent's office is duly maintained.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspection by the VFSC or the Financial Intelligence Unit during the first year of operation, higher (up to 35%) if the company declares invoices, assets, or employment within Vanuatu that rely on substantial physical presence.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] of the Republic of Vanuatu (2007 consolidated edition), principally ss. 4–8 (incorporation procedure and memorandum of association), s. 13 (shares and paid-up capital), and Part III (registered office and registered agent).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 Application for Incorporation, filed together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a Vanuatu International Company; shares may be issued with or without par value and may remain partly paid. No escrow account deposit or capitalisation undertaking is required by the VFSC at incorporation or on an ongoing basis.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] (the "Company"), an International Company incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] of Vanuatu. RESOLVED: (1) The allotment of subscribed shares is approved and share certificates shall be issued. (2) The registered office at [ADDRESS], Port Vila and the licensed registered agent are ratified. (3) [DIRECTOR NAME] is appointed Director and [SECRETARY NAME] Secretary under the Articles. (4) The Director is authorised to open bank accounts, register for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, and execute related agreements. (5) The Company's digital fitness-biometric and wellness-telemetry application business is approved. ADOPTED this [DATE].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, acting through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed company names, ranked in priority order, to the VFSC International Companies Registry through a licensed registered agent. The agent verifies that the proposed names are not identical or confusingly similar to existing entries on the Register of International Companies, do not contain prohibited words, and are not contrary to public interest. Once availability is confirmed, the name is reserved for 14 days.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport of each subscriber and intended director
Statement of intended business purpose (ISIC 6201 — digital health and fitness application development)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, a substituted name from the priority list is re-filed within three business days at no additional charge; if all proposed names are rejected, a fresh list is submitted with the standard reapplication fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed corporate services provider and Vanuatu notary public.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the VFSC-prescribed format, setting out the corporate name, registered office clause, registered agent clause, authorised share capital and share classes, and the limitation of members' liability. The memorandum must be executed by at least one subscriber in the presence of a witness or a notary public. The executed documents are then delivered to the VFSC with Form 1 for incorporation.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as first director
Consent of the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry raises a query on the constitutional documents, a supplementary or amended memorandum is filed through the registered agent within five business days, preserving the original filing priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC — International Companies Registry (official counter or approved electronic filing channel).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the executed memorandum, articles, Form 1, and the consents of directors and registered agent with the VFSC. Remit the statutory government filing fee of VT 35,000 (approximately USD 300) by bank transfer or an approved VFSC payment method and retain the official receipt as proof of filing. The Registrar reviews the application for procedural compliance with the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consents of directors and registered agent
Proof of payment of incorporation fee
Beneficial ownership and non-resident ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected or queried, the registered agent cures the defect (for example, re-notarisation or corrected form) and re-files within 14 days; expedited same-day processing is available upon payment of the fast-track fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Statutory Register Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation under the seal of the Commission, conferring separate legal personality on the International Company. The registered agent then files the notice of registered office and particulars of directors and members, and opens the statutory registers (members, directors, secretary, and charges) at the registered office in Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Registered agent resolution accepting the appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate or register contains a clerical error, return the instrument to the Registry with a written correction request; a corrected certificate or register is issued within two business days without affecting the original incorporation date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Share Allotment and Banking / Payment-Rail Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors acting under the Articles of Association and the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene and hold the First Board Meeting, or adopt a unanimous written resolution, under the Articles. Adopt the First Board Resolution approving the allotment of subscribed shares, adoption of the registered office, appointment of officers, and authorisation to open bank accounts and execute Apple IAP and Google Play Billing agreements. Issue share certificates, file the resolution with the statutory records, and complete banking KYC and payment-processor onboarding.
required_dossiers: Minutes or written resolution of the First Board Meeting
Corporate KYC pack (certificate of incorporation, memorandum, board resolution, and passport copies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or payment processor challenges the corporate authorisation, issue a certified extract of the First Board Resolution and obtain a current certificate of incumbency from the registered agent for re-submission within five business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial manufacturing board governs ISIC 6201 software activities; the relevant oversight body for regulated digital services is the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry and, where data protection applies, the Vanuatu Ministry of Justice and Community Services.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial or manufacturing operating permit required for a pure digital health-fitness application business; optional registration under the Vanuatu E-Commerce and Data Protection policy guidance may be undertaken for market credibility.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), operating under the Environment Protection & Conservation Act [Cap 283].
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Category 3 — a paperless, server-hosted software company is not a prescribed activity and is not subject to a Preliminary Environmental Assessment or a full Environmental Impact Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source wastewater or VOC emission thresholds apply to cloud-hosted application operations; if any physical servers or electronic hardware are deployed, e-waste must be recycled or disposed of in accordance with DEPC waste-management guidelines, and general energy-efficiency reporting under applicable Vanuatu regulations is advised.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No mandatory fire safety certification or structural load inspection applies to a non-physical, home-office-based digital company. If the Company leases a serviced office or data closet in Port Vila, it must obtain a Fire Service Certificate of Compliance from the Vanuatu Fire Service and a structural occupancy clearance from the Ministry of Public Works before occupation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (VRCD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; taxpayer portal: https://vrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must submit Form VAT 1 to the VRCD Commissioner of Revenue together with certified copies of the entity's certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, passports of directors and beneficial owners, an original utility bill or lease agreement proving a Vanuatu address, evidence of foreign tax identification number, and a recent bank reference. A TIN or VAT registration number is issued only when the entity makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu; a pure International Company carrying on business wholly outside Vanuatu is statutorily exempt and does not require a TIN unless it voluntarily registers for VAT. Approval generally takes 5–15 business days after complete submission.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone_Exempt_International_Company: An International Company incorporated under the Vanuatu International Companies Act is exempt from all Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and stamp duty on offshore activities, regardless of beneficial ownership or place of control. It is not resident for domestic income tax purposes and is not eligible for pass-through treatment under Vanuatu law; the entity is simply outside the tax net for non-Vanuatu-source transactions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available under Vanuatu law. The tax exemption for International Companies is automatic and non-elective. An exempt IC wishing to engage in local Vanuatu business must convert to or register as a Domestic Company (under the Companies Act) and may then be required to register for VAT; such conversion is the only statutory 'election' relevant to tax status. Hybrid mismatch rules are not enacted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax Act No. 11 of 1998, as amended)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Registration is compulsory for any supplier making taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceeding VT 1,000,000 in any 12-month period. A foreign entity without a local establishment and making supplies to Vanuatu customers is not ordinarily required to register unless it physically supplies goods or services within Vanuatu; International Companies are exempt from VAT on offshore supplies and are not subject to compulsory registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not operate a real-time electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, API, or digital stamping regime. Registered VAT suppliers may issue manual or computer-generated invoices and retain paper or PDF records for audit. No government e-invoice clearance is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export VAT zero-rating applies to goods exported from Vanuatu by a registered supplier where the goods are shipped or delivered outside Vanuatu within a reasonable period and documentary evidence of export is maintained. Zero-rating also applies to services performed for and enjoyed by non-residents outside Vanuatu, including digital health and fitness application subscriptions and biometric telemetry services delivered to non-resident customers, provided the supplier retains records showing the recipient is non-resident, the service is rendered from outside Vanuatu, and no benefit is derived from a Vanuatu domestic establishment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CusDec Entry 3B) for physical goods
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing export from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Vanuatu-licensed bank proving receipt of foreign exchange
Copy of the underlying contract or app store settlement report showing non-resident recipients
Zero-rated VAT invoice justifying the 0% treatment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating claims attract liability to the VAT withheld plus penalties up to 200% of the tax sought, daily default interest, fines of up to VT 500,000, and imprisonment of directors for up to 3 years under the Value Added Tax Act. The Commissioner may retrospectively reassess export claims for up to 5 years and reverse input credits previously claimed where export documentation proves false. Misdeclarations are also prosecuted as money-laundering offences under the Proceeds of Crime Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — the statutory Central Bank and delegated Foreign Exchange Controller under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 74]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately licenses banks and supervises the International Company registry under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV, ISO 4217) operates under a managed floating regime pegged to a trade-weighted basket of AUD, USD, NZD, EUR and JPY. Current-account payments (royalties, license fees, service fees, dividend remittances) are freely convertible through RBV-authorized dealers subject only to standard transaction documentation; capital-account outflows (loan redemptions, share buy-backs, liquidation distributions) require prior RBV exchange-control approval for resident entities. A non-resident International Company is statutorily exempted from exchange-control formalities under the IC Act, giving de facto full convertibility for USD-denominated treasury flows and eliminating profit-remittance hurdles for the Vanuatu holding vehicle of the health-fitness-app group.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters must collect export proceeds within six months of shipment and surrender balances to an authorized dealer within one month of receipt, with a statutory mandatory conversion ratio of 100% of VUV proceeds unless a specific exemption is issued. The Vanuatu International Company is outside this regime: it may retain receivables in USD or any permitted foreign currency, without conversion to VUV, provided it does not transact with Vanuatu residents, derive Vanuatu-source income, or acquire VUV-denominated assets. App-store proceeds from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing therefore flow directly into the IC's USD settlement account with no surrender obligation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: International Company Operational Account (USD and multi-currency treasury; Capital Escrow Account not applicable — no minimum capital under IC Act [Cap. 222])
International Company Operational Account (USD, AUD, EUR, VUV; offshore settlement and e-banking mandate)
Operational Account (non-resident corporate; USD/VUV; more conservative KYC with local nexus review)
Domestic retail and local business accounts; generally not suitable for non-resident IC treasury settlement

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium feasibility rat. Vanuatu has no dedicated Electronic Money Institution (EMI), digital-bank, or neobank licensing regime; only VFSC-licensed deposit-taking institutions may hold customer funds. Offshore EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Mercury) commonly decline Vanuatu-domiciled ICs because of the jurisdiction's recent FATF grey-listing history (2021–2023) and global correspondent-bank de-risking. A compliant alternative is the hybrid structure: the IC maintains its primary treasury and settlement account at ANZ or BRED Vanuatu, while regulated EMIs in Australia, New Zealand, or Singapore are used only as downstream pay-out rails for user refunds and contractor disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical-appearance barrier does not exist for directors and shareholders: the RBV and VFSC do not mandate in-person interviews at the bank. Remote onboarding is permitted using (i) certified true copies of passports and proof of residential address, (ii) a registered-agent introduction letter from a VFSC-licensed corporate services provider, and (iii) a live video verification call with the beneficial owners. The resident registered agent holds the registered office and completes the statutory client due-diligence file. In-person attendance at the Port Vila branch is required only in exceptional higher-risk cases or where the bank issues hardware e-banking tokens without courier delivery.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO/sanctions red flag: ultimate beneficial owners or investors resident in OFAC/EU/UK-sanctioned jurisdictions, or nationals of FATF grey-listed states (including Russia and high-risk money-laundering jurisdictions).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due-diligence pack prepared by the VFSC-licensed registered agent; certified passports and recently dated utility records; negative screening results from World-Check, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, or Refinitiv; sworn source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations; full corporate-structure chart evidencing that no sanctioned party holds a direct or indirect interest of 10% or more; independent legal opinion from Vanuatu counsel confirming IC Act 1992 validity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Industry-flow ambiguity: fitness-app monetization with high-volume micro-payments, perceived affiliate-reward or crypto-adjacent token incentives, and elevated chargeback/refund ratios on Apple IAP and Google Play Billing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Reviewed or audited financial statements of the IC; latest 12 months of Apple and Google developer payout statements; payment-acquirer and platform reference letters; written AML/CTF risk assessment and end-to-end payment-flow narrative; geoblocking and age-gating controls evidencing compliance with GDPR, COPPA, and applicable privacy laws; refund and dispute-management policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverified capital injection: inbound share-capital or pre-seed/seed investment without a clear paper trail, or remittances from private crypto exchanges, unregulated money-service businesses, or third-party paymasters.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed share-subscription agreement, board resolution, and updated shareholder register for the IC; investor KYC pack containing passport, investment source documents (bank statements, tax returns, dividend vouchers, exit sale agreements); source-of-funds confirmation letter signed by each investor; RBV-designated exchange-control notification form if the authorized dealer requires it; statement from the dealing bank confirming no beneficial-interest nominee ambiguity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Substance and agent-quality red flag: the IC's registered agent is unlicensed or low-reputation, the director set appears purely nominee-based, or the registered office has a history of non-compliance filings.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current VFSC International Companies Register computer extract; valid registered-agent certificate and corporate-services license; migration to a Tier-1 Port Vila agent if necessary; directors' professional CVs, AML training certificates, and identity verification; executed nominee-declaration and trust deed (if applicable); proof of annual license fee payment and good-standing certificate.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound injections are cleared via SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers from the shareholder's or investor's bank to the IC's USD settlement account at ANZ or BRED (Port Vila), with the BoP purpose code 'G100 — equity capital injection' (or 'general corporate working capital' for shareholder loans) and the memo field citing the IC name and 'International Companies Act [Cap. 222]'. The receiving bank requires the certificate of incorporation, VFSC register extract, UBO declaration, and, for amounts above approximately USD 50,000, a source-of-funds letter from the remitter; the IC exchange-control exemption means an RBV pre-approval letter is not required unless the remittance is classed as resident-connected. Verification follows standard remittance-checking (RFI/name-screening) with cleared funds available on a T+1 basis under normal VFSC settlement convention.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound operating disbursements (cloud hosting, marketing, contractor fees, sub-processor licensing, and Apple/Google payout sweepdowns) settle through SWIFT MT103 customer transfers, with MT202/MT205 cover payments for interbank legs across USD, AUD, EUR, and VUV corridors; US-technology-vendor payments use Fedwire/ACH fallbacks through the bank's USD correspondent. Large procurement items (e.g., server hardware, biometric-data processing equipment, or M&A of data assets) can be supported by documentary collections or commercial letters of credit issued via SWIFT MT700, while recurring app-store settlements flow natively through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing rails into the IC's USD account. No RBV prior authorization applies to non-resident IC outflows; the dealing bank simply retains underlying invoices and contracts in the e-KYC file for payments exceeding the internal reporting threshold.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV outright forward contracts (tenors up to 12 months) available through ANZ Vanuatu and BRED Vanuatu dealing desks for settlement of any VUV-denominated tax, regulatory, or local expenses
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV transacted with international counterparties in Singapore and New York — permissible for the non-resident IC without RBV approval
Cross-currency swaps (USD floating vs VUV fixed, or USD vs AUD) for balance-sheet hedging if the IC assumes VUV or AUD denominated liabilities

Plain-vanilla FX spot contracts executed via authorized-dealer electronic portals; exchange-traded derivatives and local futures are not available on any Vanuatu exchange and are not permissible without a VFSC securities license

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing due within 2 months after each anniversary of incorporation; annual renewal fee payable with the return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a penalty of approximately Vt 10,000 plus additional continuing fines; non-payment for 6 consecutive months may cause the Registrar to strike the IC off the Register, with restoration available only after discharge of all arrears and reinstatement fees.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a Vanuatu International Company unless it is licensed to carry on banking, insurance, trust, or securities business under Vanuatu legislation, or shareholders holding at least one-tenth of issued shares pass a valid requisition for audited accounts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory external financial reporting framework; directors must keep accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and disclose financial position with reasonable accuracy. IFRS is the standard commonly applied if voluntary audited statements are prepared.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must record every share transfer within 21 days and verify the resulting beneficial ownership chain; the annual return acts as the annual confirmation of current members and beneficial owners, and no separate amendment filing is required if no transfer or ownership change occurred during the reporting year.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$450 – US$1,000 per year for registered agent, registered office, corporate secretary, and annual return administration
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required for a non-licensed IC; a voluntary certified audit commissioned by shareholders typically ranges from US$2,500 to US$6,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company is wholly outside the Vanuatu income tax system. No corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, or stamp duty on transfers is levied. The only mandatory charge is an annual government registration fee under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222), which is not a tax on profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No income tax return applies. Compliance filing: International Companies Act Annual Return with the annual government fee, submitted via the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual government fee and return are due on or before each anniversary of incorporation (typically the last day of the month of incorporation). No income tax deadline applies because no operating income, profit, or gain is assessable to Vanuatu income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered International Company name, registration number, date of incorporation, registered office in Vanuatu, and the name and licence number of the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: May be completed by the local registered agent on behalf of non-resident owners; the register of shareholders and directors must accurately disclose beneficial ownership.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised capital, issued shares, par value, and the legal and beneficial holders of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholding is permitted; no minimum capital is required; nominee holdings must be supported by a formal declaration of trust for AML compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, nationalities, addresses, and dates of appointment of all directors and the secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only one director is required and may be a non-resident natural person; there is no requirement for a Vanuatu-resident director.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the company has complied with the International Companies Act, has a registered office and agent, and is not engaging in prohibited or insolvent trading.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the company is tax resident in another jurisdiction, identify that jurisdiction to evidence that substantive activity is not intended to be conducted in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculated tariff based on nominal share capital, payable to the VFSC through the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The fee is paid from corporate funds; no profit declaration or asset schedule is attached.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and non-payment of the required annual government fee attract default penalties and late fees. Repeated default for consecutive years can result in strike-off and dissolution under Sections 85-89 of the International Companies Act. All penalties are administrative because no corporate tax is assessed.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to shareholders, whether resident or non-resident.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network. No tax residency certificate or treaty relief application procedure is applicable to a standard offshore International Company. A non-resident shareholder seeking relief in their home jurisdiction must rely on unilateral foreign tax credit rules applicable in that foreign country; Vanuatu does not administer a certification mechanism for outbound dividends.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding rate on royalties and interest paid by an International Company. No treaty rates exist due to the absence of DTA coverage. Payments of licensing fees for the health fitness app and interest on intercompany debt are outside Vanuatu's taxing jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold exists. Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and no transfer pricing statute, so no Master File, Local File, or Country-by-Country Report is required from an International Company. Bookkeeping must still satisfy Section 32 of the International Companies Act, including records sufficient to explain transactions and financial position.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not impose tax-based economic substance filings on International Companies. However, under the International Companies Act and the VFSC beneficial ownership regime, an IC must not be a naked shell: it must maintain a registered office, retain a licensed registered agent, and maintain board minutes and accounting records. If the company is managed and controlled outside Vanuatu and is tax resident in a foreign state, no additional Vanuatu economic substance filing is due.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Artificial Substance Deficiency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company as a bare nominee shell with no physical office, no board meetings, no accounting records, and no foreign tax residency, while invoicing the fitness app subscription and advertising revenues through Vanuatu to obtain an apparent tax-free status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and dissolution under Sections 85-89 of the International Companies Act; default penalties on the annual fee; loss of the protection of limited liability in respect of creditors; denial of good standing certificates for banking or licensing purposes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for fraudulent or reckless trading, may be disqualified from managing Vanuatu entities, and may face civil restitution to creditors. Where deliberate concealment or fraud is proven, criminal liability under the Vanuatu Penal Code can result in imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abusive Transfer Pricing and Foreign Tax Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the tax-exempt International Company as an invoicing buffer to shift profits from a high-tax foreign jurisdiction via overpriced royalties or app access fees without bona fide economic substance, with the intent of evading the foreign country's income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu has no domestic tax anti-avoidance rule, but the foreign tax authority may impose adjusted tax, interest, and penalties, deny foreign treaty benefits, and trigger CRS/FATCA disclosures. Vanuatu regulators, upon evidence of misuse of the International Companies Act, may strike off or suspend the entity and exchange information through the Offshore Governance Act and mutual assistance channels.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and controlling beneficial owners who orchestrate sham arrangements may be charged with tax fraud abroad; foreign civil judgments can be enforced against them through Vanuatu courts where fraud is shown. Travel bans and asset-freezing orders may be issued through the Vanuatu Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters framework.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing suspicious funds through the health fitness app's payment rails (Apple App Store, Google Play) or through the IC's bank account to conceal criminal proceeds; failing to file beneficial ownership information with the VFSC; transacting with sanctioned persons using the IC's name.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act and the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, the company and directors are liable to substantial monetary fines, forfeiture of assets, and imprisonment. The VFSC also has power to revoke the IC's registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners may face criminal imprisonment for money-laundering offences, asset-freezing orders, and travel bans. The corporate veil is pierced where the company is used as an instrument of crime, making shareholders jointly and severally liable.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Returns and Pay Government Fees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: More than one year of non-payment of the VFSC annual government fee and non-filing of the annual return while continuing to operate the digital health app and transacting cross-border.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Default penalty and late fees accrue; after repeated default the company is struck off and dissolved under Sections 85-89 of the International Companies Act. Struck-off status invalidates the company's right to contract, hold assets, or maintain bank accounts in Vanuatu; restoration requires payment of arrears and court or administrative costs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for debts incurred after the IC has lost good standing, and may be disqualified from managing any Vanuatu-registered company for a prescribed period. Where the default accompanies fraudulent trading, directors also face criminal fines and imprisonment under Vanuatu Law.
